summary: Evidence packet for gated-shell. This introduces true governance (Consumed Attenuation) over arbitrary shell execution, answering the #101 review requirement. A caller provides allowed_prefixes, and the wrapper enforces this boundary before executing the command. It provides operational value, not just supply-chain hygiene.

dogfood.command: runx skill ./skills/gated-shell --json -i command='echo Hello World' -i allowed_prefixes='["echo", "ls"]' -R ./receipts

observations.detail: Blocks shell commands not matching allowed prefixes, emitting a governance decision receipt.
